title: Exercise for Anxiety
meta_desc: Discover how exercise can help manage anxiety in NZ, with evidence-based advice and practical steps to get started safely, including yoga, walking, and swimming options
intro: Anxiety affects many New Zealanders, with the Ministry of Health reporting that one in five Kiwis experience anxiety disorders each year. Exercise is a proven way to reduce anxiety symptoms, and certain types of physical activity are particularly beneficial. By incorporating exercise into your routine, you can take a significant step towards managing anxiety and improving your overall wellbeing.

sections.heading: Anxiety in NZ: The Facts
sections.body: According to the Ministry of Health, anxiety disorders are a significant concern in New Zealand, affecting around 20% of the population. The economic burden of anxiety is also substantial, with a recent study estimating that anxiety disorders cost the NZ economy over $1 billion annually. However, research has consistently shown that regular exercise can help alleviate anxiety symptoms, reducing the risk of developing anxiety disorders and improving overall mental health.
list: 1 in 5 Kiwis experience anxiety disorders each year
Anxiety disorders cost the NZ economy over $1 billion annually
Regular exercise can reduce anxiety symptoms by up to 40%

sections.heading: Exercise as Medicine
sections.body: The New Zealand government recognises the importance of exercise for mental health, with initiatives such as Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which offers 40-70% off gym memberships for eligible individuals. This scheme can help make exercise more accessible and affordable for those who need it most.

sections.heading: Gym Types to Reduce Anxiety
sections.body: Certain types of exercise are particularly beneficial for reducing anxiety symptoms. These include yoga, walking, and swimming, which are all low-impact activities that can be modified to suit different fitness levels. Yoga, in particular, has been shown to have a positive impact on anxiety symptoms, with its combination of physical postures, breathing techniques, and meditation helping to reduce stress and improve mood.
list: Yoga: combines physical postures, breathing techniques, and meditation to reduce stress and improve mood
Walking: a low-impact activity that can be done almost anywhere, with minimal equipment required
Swimming: a low-impact activity that can help reduce stress and improve mood, while also providing a full-body workout

sections.heading: Getting Started Safely
sections.body: Additionally, many gyms in NZ offer introductory sessions or beginner classes, which can be a great way to get started with exercise in a supportive and supervised environment. Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme can also help make gym memberships more affordable, with discounts of 40-70% off available for eligible individuals.
